id: title:eli-r-ph:cap ingestion warnings per type per pod

review.posthog_relevance: Adds ingestion warning delivery reliability and observability. P1.F3.H3 configures a bounded warning emission rate per type, while P1.F7.H2 removes the previous token-only suppression, potentially allowing more warnings to reach users. This could reduce dropped warnings and distinguish this drop reason from other failures.

observations.behavior: Adds a per-type budget to the warning throttle, allowing a pod to emit a bounded number of warnings of a single type regardless of token count.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent a pod from being overwhelmed by a single warning type, potentially reducing dropped warnings and improving reliability of ingestion warning delivery.

observations.behavior: Adds a new outcome label for the metric when a warning is dropped due to the per-type budget being exhausted.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows monitoring of this specific drop reason, distinguishing it from other throttling or delivery failures.
